svg.title: Verified controller wording, independently typeset
svg.desc: Transparent editable overlay. Only CONTROL PAD, 1 START and 2 were transcribed from the inspected controller photograph. No photographic pixels or SEGA wordmark. Generic fonts are not claimed to reproduce original typography. Approximate label placement follows the existing mesh: SVG x = local X in millimeters + 53.5; SVG y = local Z in millimeters + 22. Requires visual integration verification before use.
